meta.siteDescription: Independent medical information about cosmetic surgery and aesthetic medicine, and contact with qualified, verified surgeons.
meta.ogTagline: Independent medical information and verified surgeons

footer.disclaimer: The information on this site does not replace a medical consultation. Only a qualified surgeon, after examining you, can tell you whether a procedure is right for you.
footer.independence: Independent platform: no commission on procedures, no paid rankings.

home.title: Understand before you decide
home.lead: Clear medical information, risks included, and surgeons whose qualifications we check. No sales pressure.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
body: [TO COMPLETE after the data protection impact assessment and appointment of the DPO.]
Data collected: planned procedure, closed medical questions, contact details. Legal basis: your explicit consent (UK GDPR Article 9(2)(a)).
Recipients: only the surgeons you select. Hosting: European Union.
Retention: 6 months after your request is sent. You can access, correct or delete your data or withdraw consent at any time, and complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO).
privacy.description: How we protect your health data: purposes, consent, retention periods, hosting and how to exercise your rights.

methodology.title: How we work
body: Content: every guide follows an editorial charter that rules out any promise of results and requires a section on risks. It is reviewed by a named, qualified surgeon, with the review date shown.
Surgeon verification: we check every surgeon against the official register in their country, then again every year.
Ranking: surgeons are listed by specialty, location and languages spoken. No surgeon can pay to rank higher.
Funding: surgeons pay a fixed subscription, regardless of how many requests they receive. We take no commission on procedures.
methodology.description: How we write and medically review our pages, verify surgeons and stay independent, with no commission or paid ranking.

join.description: Are you a qualified surgeon? Apply to join: we check your specialist registration with the official register before anything is published. Fixed subscription, no commission, no paid ranking.
join.title: Surgeons: join the directory
join.lead: The directory only lists surgeons whose specialist title we have checked with the official register of their country. Applying takes two minutes.
model: A fixed subscription: no commission on procedures, no payment per request received.
Alphabetical order: nobody can pay to be listed higher.
Patients choose 1 to 3 surgeons themselves; their request goes only to them.
No reviews, before-and-after photos or prices on your profile, in line with the rules of your country.
steps: We check your registration, specialist title, indemnity cover and the registration of your practice.
A 20-minute call, then you sign the subscription agreement and the editorial charter.
We create your account (two-factor authentication required) and draft your profile, which you approve before it goes live.
